title: Color Whip
summary: Pure non-representational color at warehouse tempo. No object — no blob, no sphere, no horizon, no figure. Eight six-second dialects: strobe invert, whip smear, phosphor stack, smash zoom, channel chase, hard cuts, vortex spin-up, white hit. The slow sibling is Chroma Bath. This one hits.
visualArc: Kick-locked invert → smear streaks → afterimage pile → smash zoom tunnel → RGB plates at three speeds → six hard hue swaps → vortex past readable → one white punch and wreckage.

segments.label: A — Strobe
segments.onScreen: Full-frame magenta and acid-lime invert on every kick. Fifteen punches. One-frame black between. Nothing else moves.
segments.musicCue: Twilight Time, 150 BPM. Color inverts on the kick. No swell, no fade.
segments.grokImaginePrompt: Cinematic 8K still of a pure non-representational color field filling the entire frame, caught mid-invert between full-frame magenta and full-frame acid lime, the two hues occupying the frame as hard adjacent slabs meeting on an off-center jagged seam rather than a blend, one-frame black punch visible as a thin torn edge along the seam, no objects no horizon no figures no text, asymmetric, not kaleidoscopic, not mirrored, photographed CRT phosphor not digital gradient, anamorphic 2.39:1, Grok Imagine style
segments.geminiOmniPrompt: Photoreal cinematic 8K video, 6 seconds, one continuous locked-off shot. Full-frame non-representational color field, no objects, no horizon, no figures. The entire frame hard-inverts between saturated magenta and acid lime on every musical kick at 150 BPM — fifteen inversions. Each kick is one black frame then the other hue already present. No fades, no dissolves, no slow drift, no camera move. Jagged off-center seam during the invert, never a blend, never brown. Asymmetric, not kaleidoscopic, not mirrored. Photoreal CRT phosphor texture. Nothing resolves into a shape. No cuts, no new elements.

segments.musicCue: Twilight Time. Smear length locked to the kick; streaks refresh every 0.4s.

segments.musicCue: Twilight Time. Each kick adds a ghost; ghosts never fully die in six seconds.

segments.musicCue: Twilight Time drop. Spin doubles every four kicks. Last kicks are unreadable.

segments.musicCue: Twilight Time. One kick is the white punch (about 0:44). Wreckage chatters on the remaining kicks. Hard out at 0:48, no tail.
